claim: Previous flu vaccines may have made President Donald Trump susceptible to COVID-19
justification: High-confidence evidence from both fact-checks indicates that mainstream health agencies like the CDC and WHO have explicitly refuted claims that flu vaccines increase susceptibility to COVID-19, with no known biological mechanism or credible studies supporting such a link. Additionally, there is no record of President Donald Trump or his physicians attributing his COVID-19 infection to flu vaccines. Low-confidence evidence suggesting support for the claim is contradicted by authoritative sources and likely fabricated, making it unreliable for anchoring the verdict.
